title.zh: 反馈与控制 · 双轮车为什么倒不下去
title.en: Feedback & Control · Why the Two-Wheeled Bot Never Falls

desc.zh: 一辆双轮车天生站不住，让它站住的不是更强的电机，而是一个转得够快的圈。亲手当一回控制器、亲手调坏再调好一套 PID，再让延迟、噪声和饱和逐个来拆台。
desc.en: A two-wheeled balancing bot is born unable to stand. What keeps it up is not a stronger motor but a loop that spins fast enough. Take the controller's seat yourself, tune a PID badly then well, and let delay, noise and saturation each try to wreck it.
